item.title: JIJ Raises US$5.2 Million in Funding Led by Global Brain
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — JIJ Inc. (“JIJ”), developer of a quantum- and AI-enabled optimization platform, today announced that it has raised JPY 840 million, approximately US$5.2 million, in equity financing, with Global Brain Corporation (“Global Brain”) serving as the lead investor.
